name: std::error_code::message
intro:
Returns the message corresponding to the current error code value and category.

Equivalent to category().message(value()).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The error message corresponding to the current error code value and category.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Represent invalid_argument, inspect it, copy it, and clear it. Error messages depend on the implementation.

summary: Returns the message corresponding to the current error code value and category.
